choose: to pick one or more from a group
lose: to stop having something that is important to you
draw: to make a picture of something with a pencil or pen
recycle: to want something to happen and think that it could happen

Then the waves took me to a giant trash island. I saw a lot of plastic waste. I wanted to get out of there.
One day, a strong storm freed me. After weeks, I finally reached land. There were a lot of people at the beach. "Where am I going now?," I thought.
(A)What a long journey! I am finally in a bathtub with this boy, Mike. How lucky I am! But sometimes I think about my other duck friends. Are they still in the ocean? I hope to see them all someday.

20 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 영영풀이가 적절하지 않은 것은?
① ⓐ: a raised line of water that moves across the surface of a body of water
② ⓑ: very bad weather with strong winds and usually rain, thunder, or snow
③ ⓒ: to arrive at; to get to a place
④ ⓓ: an area of sand or small rocks next to an ocean or lake
⑤ ⓔ: to continue to exist or happen
